2608.31082.title: Token-Efficient Data Reasoning Agents via Adaptive Structuring of Unstructured Data
2608.31082.paper_summary: Valuable data remains embedded in unstructured sources: web pages, reports, contracts, filings, earnings calls, and PDFs. The big bet in enterprise AI is deploying LLM agents that reason over this data to answer complex questions for every knowledge worker. Agents can do this today, but at prohibitive cost. Each question repeatedly opens large documents to recover scattered evidence, consuming up to a million tokens. However, if the data were already structured, the same question would reduce to a cheap database lookup. For example, on FanOutQA benchmark, reasoning over an ideal pre-structured store is 28X cheaper, and the gap grows to orders of magnitude as questions fan out over more documents. Yet structuring everything in advance is not viable: documents hold vastly more possible structure than any workload will use, and the useful structure and documents are unknown until queries arrive. We propose agentic data cracking, a method that structures unstructured data adaptively and speculatively as a byproduct of reasoning itself. Structuring is adaptive because observed queries decide when it happens and what matters, and speculative because it goes beyond the current question. Whenever the agent opens a document to answer, a cracking sub-agent forks from the already-loaded context at marginal cost and extracts grounded structure likely to serve related future queries. Over time, an increasing share of queries is fully covered by structured data and answered without opening a document, keeping agentic accuracy at close to RAG cost. On FanOutQA, extended with merely one related question per test question, cracking cuts cost by 53% while preserving accuracy. Agentic data cracking is a first step toward next-generation data infrastructure for agentic reasoning over unstructured data: a shared substrate beneath the model where knowledge that reasoning already paid to uncover accumulates.
2608.31082.paper_summary_zh: 有價值的數據仍然嵌入在非結構化的來源中：網頁、報告、合同、申報、財報電話會議和PDF檔案。企業AI的重大賭注是部署LLM代理，讓它們能夠對這些數據進行推理，以回答每位知識工作者的複雜問題。代理今天可以做到這一點，但成本卻非常高昂。每個問題都會重複打開大型文件以恢復分散的證據，消耗多達一百萬個標記。然而，如果數據已經結構化，則相同的問題將簡化為便宜的數據庫查詢。例如，在FanOutQA基準上，對理想的預結構化存儲進行推理的成本便宜28倍，隨著問題在更多文件中擴展，這一差距會增長到幾個數量級。然而，事先結構化所有內容並不可行：文件中潛在的結構遠遠超過任何工作負載所需的結構，而有用的結構和文件在查詢到達之前是未知的。我們提出了代理數據破解，這是一種在推理過程中自適應和推測性地結構化非結構化數據的方法。結構化是自適應的，因為觀察到的查詢決定了何時發生以及什麼是重要的，並且是推測性的，因為它超越了當前的問題。每當代理打開一個文件以回答問題時，一個破解子代理會以邊際成本從已加載的上下文中分叉出來，並提取可能服務於相關未來查詢的基礎結構。隨著時間的推移，越來越多的查詢完全由結構化數據覆蓋，並且在不打開文件的情況下得到回答，保持代理的準確性接近RAG成本。在FanOutQA上，僅在每個測試問題中擴展一個相關問題，破解成本降低53%，同時保持準確性。代理數據破解是朝著下一代數據基礎設施邁出的第一步，旨在實現對非結構化數據的代理推理：模型下方的共享基質，知識在推理過程中已經付出代價以揭示並積累。
